label: toatte
title: とあって
meaning: Because ~; ~ as expected; because ~, naturally ~; Introduces an expected reason for some circumstance that is different from the usual situation.
meaning_example: Because this is the series of holidays after the bonus season, (unsurprisingly), all the tourist spots are crowded.

notes.text: Ref # Kanzen Master Level 1 - p21 - no.21
Ref # A Dictionary of Advanced Japanese Grammar p613
notes.html: Ref # A Dictionary of Advanced Japanese Grammar p613

examples.japanese: ボーナス後の連休とあって、観光地はどこも人でいっぱいだ。
examples.body_text:
ボーナス後の連休とあって、観光地はどこも人でいっぱいだ。 

Because 
		this is the series of holidays after the bonus season, unsurprisingly, all the tourist spots are crowded.
examples.body_html:
ボーナス後の連休とあって、観光地はどこも人でいっぱいだ。 
Because this is the series of holidays after the bonus season, unsurprisingly, all the tourist spots are crowded.

examples.japanese: 夏休みが始まったとあって、子供たちはみんな嬉しそうだ。
examples.body_text:
夏休みが始まったとあって、子供たちはみんな嬉しそうだ。 

		Summer vacation has begun, 
		so 
		the children all look happy.
examples.body_html:
夏休みが始まったとあって、子供たちはみんな嬉しそうだ。 
Summer vacation has begun, so the children all look happy.

examples.japanese: 人気スターがやって来るとあって、空港は大勢の人たちが待ち受けていた
examples.body_text:
人気スターがやって来るとあって、空港は大勢の人たちが待ち受けていた 

because 
		a popular star is coming, a large crowd gathered to meet him at the airport
examples.body_html:
人気スターがやって来るとあって、空港は大勢の人たちが待ち受けていた 
because a popular star is coming, a large crowd gathered to meet him at the airport

examples.japanese: 掃除が終わったらお菓子がもらえるとあって、子供たちは一所懸命手伝っている。
examples.body_text:
掃除が終わったらお菓子がもらえるとあって、子供たちは一所懸命手伝っている。 

Because 
		they know they'll get sweets after they finish cleaning, the children are doing their very best to help out.
examples.body_html:
掃除が終わったらお菓子がもらえるとあって、子供たちは一所懸命手伝っている。 
Because they know they'll get sweets after they finish cleaning, the children are doing their very best to help out.
